items.evidence: README's play command (leverage play .../work --ticks 1 --seed 1 --settings s0) printed one JSON object at screen title with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts (plus focus).
--frame frames/play.png --size 800x480 after a 5830-tick run wrote a PNG whose header reads 800 x 480; also title, settings and shop frames.
Fresh run: texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue. 0:enter -> tick 1 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, 'Wave 1 of 8'.

In Settings: 11 Lefts took volume 8 -> 0 and stayed 0; Rights took it to 10 and stayed 10. Language en -> es -> fr, and a further Right stayed fr; Left gave es. Difficulty Normal by default -> hard (stays) -> normal -> easy (stays).

With es and fr kept: title (incl. Continuar/Continuer), settings, play HUD, paused, shop (including 'completo/llena', 'complet/pleine' lines), won and lost texts were all in that language; only the game's name stayed English.
Run 1 set volume 0, Spanish, Easy with --settings sB; run 2 with sB printed volume 0, language es, difficulty easy and Start gave gate 14; a new folder printed volume 8, en, normal.
Up held from tick 10: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 at tick 11, 7 at tick 20, 12 at tick 70 and stayed 12; Down then took it to 0 at tick 220 and it stayed 0 (0.1 a tick = 6 units/s).
Shoot held from tick 10: bolts were born at x=2 on ticks 11, 35, 59 (24 apart), moving 0.2333 a tick (14/s); a bolt at 19.9667 on tick 88 was gone on tick 89.
Seed 1: walkers entered at x=20 on ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 in lanes 2, 4, 8, 6, 6, health 2, moving 0.025 a tick (1.5/s); no 6th one.

Guard at y=2 shooting: the walker in lane 2 went 2 -> 1 and the bolt vanished; next hit at tick 130 removed it, score 0 -> 10, coins 0 -> 1. A bolt at y=2 crossed the walker at y=4 (x about 18.3, tick 160) and it kept health 2.

Passive run: walker at x=0.025 on tick 800 gone on tick 801, gate 10 -> 9, score and coins stay 0. A later run reaching gate 0 showed screen lost with texts ['You lost','Score: 530','Best: ...','Enter: title'].
Difficulty Easy kept: Start gave gate_health 14 ('Puerta: 14'); Hard kept: Start gave gate_health 7, in the same and in a later run.

Wave 1 passive: tick 1161 screen shop, wave 1, saved true; texts 'Coins: 0', 'Next: wave 2 of 8', 'Quick hands: 0/2, 5 coins', 'Heavy bolts: 0/1, 12 coins', 'Mason: gate 5/10, 4 coins', 'Next wave'. Up held and Escape there: guard_y stayed 6, screen stayed shop, no enemies/bolts.

After Quick hands (5 coins) held shoot fired on ticks 420, 438, 456 (18 apart); after the second (10 coins) on 2555, 2567, 2579, 2591 (12 apart). Enter on 'Quick hands: 2/2, done' with 34 coins left coins 34 and quick 2.
After Heavy bolts (coins 17 -> 5): at tick 1948 one bolt removed a walker at health 2 (score 240 -> 250). Enter on 'Heavy bolts: 1/1, done' with 34 coins: coins and heavy unchanged.
Gate 9/10 with 11 coins: Mason -> gate 10, coins 7 (not 12). Mason again at 10/10: no change. Gate 5/10 with 0 coins: Enter on Mason left coins 0, gate 5.

Enter on Next wave at tick 542 -> play at 543, first walker at x=20 on tick 603 (60 ticks later). Wave 2 sent 7 walkers (lanes 4,10,6,10,10,8,2); HUD 'Wave 2 of 8' / 'Oleada 2 de 8' / 'Vague 2 sur 8'.
Wave 3 sent 6 walkers then 4 runners, 72 ticks apart; runners health 1 moving 0.05 a tick (3/s); each runner killed added 15 points and 1 coin (e.g. tick 1600: 180 -> 195, 13 -> 14).
Wave 4: 8 walkers then a brute (health 6, 1/60 unit a tick); wave 4 played out gave +120 points (80 + 40) and +11 coins (8 + 3). A brute reaching the gate took gate 4 -> 1.
modules/work/data/waves.json holds walkers/runners/brutes/every per wave, read by lib.rs via include_str; README 'How to change a wave' explains it. Observed waves matched the table.
A full seed-1 run of all 8 waves ended at tick 6024 on screen won, score 1540 = 1340 points destroyed + 20 x 10 gate; saved false; Enter at 6030 -> title at 6031.

Escape pauses (enemies and bolts frozen from tick 51 to 200) and Title returns to the title, but Enter on the focused Resume button (p_resume) does nothing: still paused 150 ticks later. Only a second Escape resumes. The button's action 'resume' is never received by the rules.
saved becomes true when the shop opens, but a second headless run with the same --settings folder starts with saved false and no Continue; README admits the saved run is kept for the session only.

In one session: bought Quick hands at shop 1, played into wave 2, paused, Title, Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1; Next wave -> wave 2 began 60 ticks later. Works only within a session (see l23).
Title from pause left saved true and Continue on the title; Start then printed saved false and the title had no Continue; won and lost screens printed saved false.

A lost run ending at 530 shows 'Best: 530' on the lost screen, but if the headless run ends there, the next run's title shows 'Best: 0': best is only kept once Enter is pressed on the end screen. It works with Enter: 1540 was kept and shown later, and a later 530 did not replace it. Also 'best' reads 0 at tick 0 of a run with a kept best.
Two 2600-tick runs, same seed and script, from identical copies of a kept folder: outputs byte-identical. Seed 2 put wave 1 in lanes 4,8,4,2,8 and seed 7 in 10,6,2,2,4 (seed 1: 2,4,8,6,6).

Wave-8 frame: gate bar on the left, blue guard at (2,8), green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brutes, white bolts, all at the state's positions (40 px a unit); HUD 'Score: 1,000 Coins: 54 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 6'.

Frames: Spanish title with Ajustes focused, French settings with 'Langue : Français' focused, English shop with Mason focused; focused entry has a bright outline (the primary button is also filled blue).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json; play.json uses only @keys and {state} values, lib.rs only message keys; README 'How to add a language' gives the steps.
README covers keys and screens, where things are kept (settings.json in the --settings folder; saved run session-only, stated), and the play and frame commands, which worked as written.

defects: The pause menu's Resume button does nothing when chosen with Enter; only Escape resumes.
The saved run is not kept between launches (session only), against the brief's 'kept'.
The best score is written only when Enter is pressed on the won/lost screen; quitting there loses it. It is capped at 1700 and only multiples of 5 are kept (340 hidden buttons).
The JSON 'best' reads 0 at tick 0 of a run whose kept best is higher (the title text is right).
The shooting cooldown carries over across the shop, so the first shot of a new wave can wait up to 24 ticks.
Primary-styled buttons (Start, Next wave) are always filled blue, which can look selected next to the focused button's outline.
